propositions: reconcile-bridge.yml does not set merge.ours.driver in the tickets worktree, causing git to fall back to 3-way text merge instead of local-wins behaviour for the 18MB bridge_state JSON file
the merge=ours attribute in .gitattributes references an undefined driver on the GHA runner since the configuration is only set per-clone in init.py and never committed
reconcile-bridge-canary.yml already obtains merge.ours.driver via its rebar init call, but reconcile-bridge.yml's bare worktree add never invokes rebar init
merge.ours.driver must be configured before any merge step to prevent blob materialization failures during reconverge with blob:none filtering
the defect causes silent fallback to text merge instead of rejecting or enforcing local-wins semantics for bridge state files
